activities.anchor: The story begins with Giorgio Vasari
activities.caption: rebuild the arc — how the discipline made itself
activities.name: ahmArcOrder

config.prompt: Five centuries of instruments — put the discipline's milestones in order:
items: Vasari's Lives invents biography-driven, teleological art history (1550)
Winckelmann adds period-style and the Greek pinnacle (1764)
Wölfflin builds formal analysis from paired categories (1915)
Riegl's Kunstwollen makes 'decline' a category error
Warburg traces images' afterlife and founds the library as laboratory
Panofsky systematises the three-level iconographic ladder
config.why: Each step corrects the last: genius and progress installed, then replaced by instruments — form, period intention, cultural memory, symbol. The modern pluralism is the accumulated set.

activities.anchor: a fixed chronology of styles and masters
activities.caption: find the faulty line — the tourist's summary
activities.name: ahmChronSpot

config.prompt: This summary of the discipline contains one faulty line — click it:
lines: Vasari's Lives (1550) invented biography-driven art history with progress built in.
Winckelmann's History of Ancient Art (1764) set Greek art as the universal pinnacle.
The resulting chronology of styles and masters is a fixed, assumption-free framework that methods merely discovered.
Vasari's progress narrative served Tuscan court politics; Winckelmann's pinnacle served Enlightenment aesthetics.
The historiographic reflex — who wrote this, with what tools, for whom — applies to today's textbooks too.
config.correction: The chronology is a PRODUCT of particular methods with particular assumptions — Vasari's and Winckelmann's choices were later exposed as choices, not discoveries.
config.why: The expert asks who wrote the account, with what tools, for what audience; the tourist memorises its output as if it had fallen from the sky.

activities.caption: file the responses — method follows the object
activities.name: ahmMediaBuckets

config.prompt: Contemporary media broke the stable-object evidence base. File each response:

items.label: how a contemporary painter builds a surface
Paik's video walls and deteriorating tape
performance preserved in scores, instructions, re-enactment
the studio archive as primary source
the install record and the code repository

config.why: As the media changed, what counts as 'the work' was renegotiated — the certificate, the instruction sheet or the database entry may be the work, and method must follow the object.

activities.anchor: what is it for, and who is it for
activities.caption: pair each era with its answer to 'who is the art for?'
activities.name: ahmPurposeMatch

config.prompt: The oldest questions, answered era by era — pair them:

pairs.right: Durand-Ruel backing the Impressionists — the market as patron

config.why: Purpose is plural and positional — the contemporary field multiplies the answers rather than replacing them.

activities.caption: drag the divider — one work, its contexts
activities.name: ahmPurposeCompare

config.prompt: Same work, different rooms — drag between the two readings:

before.label: The artist's stated purpose
before.text: Made as critique — the 'original intention', one document in the file.

after.label: What the work did in each context
after.text: Acquired as investment, exhibited as education, reposted as decoration — four purposes, none false; the historian asks what the work did in each rather than which context is real.

config.why: Purpose settles nothing on its own: the intention is a document, not the file's conclusion.

activities.caption: stage the 1989 hang — the global map in a room
activities.name: ahmGlobalBranch

config.root: Paris, 1989. You are staging Magiciens de la Terre: Aboriginal sand painting and Richard Long for the same exhibition.

start.text: How do you hang the map?

choices.label: Pair them as 'west plus the rest' mirror images
choices.feedback: The historical choice — and the controversy.

choices.label: Give each object its own full context: maker, place, tradition
Show only the Western work; keep the sand painting in storage

mirror.text: Decontextualisation: the 'west plus the rest' hang staged a global map but read one side as raw material — the controversy taught the field more than the successes.

context.text: Each object carries its own art history: trade routes, empires, diasporas and media flows as the spine, 'the West' one node in a network rather than the network's centre.

store.text: The traditional geography survives: everywhere else as exotic context, the masks as catalyst for Western innovation, never as makers' art history — the frame the postcolonial critique dismantled.

config.why: The exhibition is historiography in gallery form — the hang itself is a claim about whose art history counts.

activities.caption: fill the blanks — naming the lens
activities.name: ahmLensCloze

config.text: One installation may be read formally, iconographically, sociologically and politically in a single essay — so the expert's core skill is %%0%%: knowing which lens is in use, what it reveals, and what it %%1%% cannot see. The lenses are instruments with documented strengths and blind spots, not opinions.
config.hint: The discipline's pluralism is a bench of instruments — name the one in your hand, and its documented blind spot.

activities.anchor: bench of instruments, not an absence
activities.caption: true or false — pluralism's standards
activities.name: ahmPluralismJudge

statements.s: An interpretation is accountable to the object — what is visibly there.
statements.why: Formal analysis survives as description's discipline: every strong interpretation still starts with what is visibly there.

statements.s: Postmodern pluralism means any interpretation is as good as any other.
statements.why: The methods compete and correct each other — the opposite of anything-goes.

statements.s: Reading Warhol's Brillo boxes as pure mysticism fails the object test; reading them as purely commercial fails the method test.
statements.why: An interpretation answers to the object, to context, and to its own stated method — all three.

statements.s: Formal analysis was made obsolete once iconography arrived.
statements.why: It survives as description's discipline — Wölfflin's instruments still open every strong reading.
